Rhythm / lag anomaly: compare each station's z-series to its district (same pollutant) peer-average z-series, at lags -3..3 steps (4h each) ===\nrows = []\nfor district, sdf in stations.groupby('district'):\n    for p, pdf in sdf.groupby(pol.reindex(sdf.station_id).values):\n        ids = pdf.station_id.tolist()\n        if len(ids) < 4:\n            continue\n        zsub = zwide[ids]\n        for sid in ids:\n            peer_z = zsub.drop(columns=[sid]).mean(axis=1)\n            s = zsub[sid]\n            lag_corrs = {}\n            for lag in range(-3,4):\n                s_shift = s.shift(lag)\n                v = s_shift.notna() & peer_z.notna()\n                lag_corrs[lag] = s_shift[v].corr(peer_z[v]) if v.sum()>=8 else np.nan\n            corr0 = lag_corrs[0]\n            best_lag = max(lag_corrs, key=lambda k: (lag_corrs[k] if pd.notna(lag_corrs[k]) else -99))\n            best_corr = lag_corrs[best_lag]\n            rows.append(dict(station_id=sid, district=district, pollutant=p, n_peers=len(ids)-1,\n                              corr0=corr0, best_lag=best_lag, best_corr=best_corr,\n                              improvement=best_corr-corr0))\nrhythm_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)\nprint(\"=== RHYTHM ANOMALY CANDIDATES (low corr0, but improved at nonzero lag) ===\")\ncand = rhythm_df[(rhythm_df.best_lag != 0) & (rhythm_df.corr0 < 0.5)].sort_values('improvement', ascending=False)\nprint(cand.head(20).to_string())\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Lowest corr0 overall ===\")\nprint(rhythm_df.sort_values('corr0').head(15).to_string())\n\nrhythm_df.to_csv('/app/rhythm.csv', index=False)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CcrjP5dTftWBubXM2SZA6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Q3ZRSgeS8jxnubLAAc8p8r","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/analysis4.py","content":"import pandas as pd\nimport numpy as np\n\npd.set_option('display.width', 220)\npd.set_option('display.max_rows', 300)\n\nstations = pd.read_csv('/app/dataset/stations.csv')\nreadings_raw = pd.read_csv('/app/dataset/readings.csv')\nreadings = pd.read_csv('/app/dataset/readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\n\npol = readings_raw.drop_duplicates('station_id').set_index('station_id')['pollutant']\nreadings = readings.merge(stations[['station_id','district']], on='station_id')\n\nwide = readings.pivot(index='timestamp', columns='station_id', values='current_reading').sort_index()\nwide_interp = wide.interpolate(method='linear', limit=2, limit_direction='both')\n\nhours = wide_interp.index.hour\nhour_slots = sorted(hours.unique())  # [0,4,8,12,16,20]\nn_slots = len(hour_slots)\n\n# hour-of-day profile per station: mean over days for each hour slot\nprofile = wide_interp.groupby(hours).mean()  # index=hour, columns=station_id\n\n# z-score each station's profile (shape only)\nzprofile = (profile - profile.mean()) / profile.std()\n\nrows = []\nfor district, sdf in stations.groupby('district'):\n    for p, pdf in sdf.groupby(pol.reindex(sdf.station_id).values):\n        ids = pdf.station_id.tolist()\n        if len(ids) < 6:\n            continue\n        zsub = zprofile[ids]\n        for sid in ids:\n            peer_prof = zsub.drop(columns=[sid]).mean(axis=1)\n            s = zsub[sid]\n            shift_corrs = {}\n            for shift in range(n_slots):\n                s_shifted = np.roll(s.values, shift)\n                shift_corrs[shift] = np.corrcoef(s_shifted, peer_prof.values)[0,1]\n            corr0 = shift_corrs[0]\n            best_shift = max(shift_corrs, key=lambda k: shift_corrs[k])\n            best_corr = shift_corrs[best_shift]\n            rows.append(dict(station_id=sid, district=district, pollutant=p, n_peers=len(ids)-1,\n                              corr0=corr0, best_shift=best_shift, best_corr=best_corr,\n                              improvement=best_corr-corr0))\n\ndf = pd.DataFrame(rows)\ndf.to_csv('/app/rhythm_profile.csv', index=False)\nprint(\"=== Sorted by corr0 (lowest = worst shape match at zero shift) ===\")\nprint(df.sort_values('corr0').head(20).to_string())\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Sorted by improvement (best_shift != 0) ===\")\nprint(df[df.best_shift!=0].sort_values('improvement', ascending=False).head(20).to_string())\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":647,"cache_read_input_tokens":58066,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":647,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":9,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d846832-ae12-4b16-aebc-e32e02a4e7d7","uuid":"c1fc621f-e01e-4445-a8ca-688909941fad","request_id":"req_011CcrjP4ymQmZNhFM2NvsqE"}
